_comment: v1 mapping for Perak, derived from mapping.melaka.json by lib/make_state_mapping.py. moduls/categories/anchors reused (shared schema family, filtered to existing tables). urusans EMPTY until curated from Perak's own BPMNs — Melaka's journeys do NOT port.
label: Perak

moduls.label: Pelupusan
moduls.description: Land disposal — granting, leasing, reservation, occupation licences. Internal officers + AWAM portal.

moduls.label: Pendaftaran
moduls.description: Land-title registry. Receives approved applications from Pelupusan + handles direct title operations.

moduls.label: Hasil
moduls.description: Revenue / cukai — fees, payments, tax collection on land transactions.

moduls.label: Strata
moduls.description: Strata-titled property — apartments, condominiums, mixed developments.

moduls.label: Penguatkuasaan
moduls.description: Enforcement — violations, notices, compounds against land owners.

moduls.label: Pengambilan
moduls.description: Land acquisition by the state — compensation, gazette notices.

moduls.label: Teknikal
moduls.description: Technical Department records — surveyor reports, technical investigations. IT-side module, supports cross-module flows.

moduls.label: Consent
moduls.description: Consent applications. Lives inside umm_* and plp_* (no dedicated prefix found). Distinguishable by urusan_kod.

moduls.label: Pembangunan
moduls.description: Development applications. Lives inside umm_* and plp_* (no dedicated prefix found). Distinguishable by urusan_kod.

moduls.label: Lelong
moduls.description: Auction / public sale of land. Lives inside umm_* (no dedicated prefix found). Distinguishable by urusan_kod.

moduls.label: Shared (cross-modul)
moduls.description: Tables used by every modul: umm_=umum/application, ind_=induk/lookup, rjk_=rujukan/codes, pcp_=pengguna/access, skg_=document storage.

moduls.label: Operations & Subsystems
moduls.description: Audit, migrations, temp tables, reports, system tooling. Not business-domain but lives in et_main.

anchor_blurbs.umm_aplikasi: The application hub. Every transaction joins back here via aplikasi_id. No urusan_kod column — JOIN to ind_ursn via ursn_id.
anchor_blurbs.plp_a_pelupusan: PLP-side container for pelupusan applications (officer-internal). Promoted from plp_p_pelupusan via the AWAM→PLP SPOC integration.
anchor_blurbs.plp_p_pelupusan: Portal-side container (AWAM/Pra). Holds the applicant's submission before it's accepted by PLP.
anchor_blurbs.umm_a_hkmlk: Hakmilik (land title) attached to an application. Join-graph centre on the internal side.
anchor_blurbs.umm_p_hkmlk: Portal-side hakmilik. Promoted to umm_a_hkmlk on PLP submission.
anchor_blurbs.umm_a_permohonan_tnh: Land-permit application detail. Links umm_a_rizab via a_permohonan_tnh_id.
anchor_blurbs.umm_a_pihak_bkptg: Party / stakeholder table. The applicant (pemohon) lives here with flag_pemohon='Y'.
anchor_blurbs.ind_ursn: Urusan (business workflow) reference. All urusan codes (PT, PLPS, PRBB, ...) defined here.
anchor_blurbs.ind_tgsn: Tugasan (task code) reference. Defines workflow step codes (PYSK, SSK, PSSK, ...).
anchor_blurbs.umm_a_tgsn: Application's current and past task instances. Joined to ind_tgsn + ind_pejabat + pcp_pengguna for the canonical task-state query.
anchor_blurbs.umm_p_aplikasi: Portal-side application hub (AWAM). The _p_ counterpart of umm_aplikasi — every Pra-Aplikasi submission joins back here. Gets promoted to umm_aplikasi during SPOC handoff.
